item.description:

A critical vulnerability in the Funnel Builder plugin for WordPress is being actively exploited to inject malicious JavaScript snippets into WooCommerce checkout pages. [...]

item.title: 🟠 Microsoft Exchange, Windows 11 hacked on second day of Pwn2Own
item.description:
Why this matters: Could impact email access or mail flow — monitor delivery and client issues.
​During the second day of Pwn2Own Berlin 2026, competitors collected $385,750 in cash awards after exploiting 15 unique zero-day vulnerabilities in multiple products, including Windows 11, Microsoft Exchange, and Red Hat Enterprise Linux for Workstations. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 6h ago

item.title: 🔴 Popular node-ipc npm package compromised to steal credentials
item.description:
